subject: Post-call: SOC 2, audit logs & DPA — recap + next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2, audit logs & DPA — recap + next steps

Hi Alice,

Thanks for taking the time today — appreciate the thoughtful questions. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so your security and legal teams have a single source of truth.

Summary of pain points you called out:
- Need SOC 2 Type II evidence covering our hosted API and logging pipeline; clarity on the scope (app + infra).
- Audit/log retention policy and ability to configure retention per-tenant (you mentioned 90 days vs 1 year).
- Request-level auditability: request IDs, user identifiers, and whether logs include request/response metadata for investigations.
- DPA redline and data residency/processing terms for EU/PII.
- Pen test evidence (summary + remediation timeline).

What we heard as goals:
- Short-term: confirm SOC2 scope and provide pen-test summary + sample retention configuration so Acme can complete its security questionnaire.
- Mid-term: schedule a technical deep-dive to validate logging formats, retention enforcement, and KMS key management.
- Business: align on DPA redline and path to procurement (PO + SOW).

Immediate deliverables (owners & ETA):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf (attached) — Marissa — EOD 8/2 (attached).
- Pen test summary + remediation status (high-level) — Marissa & Security — 8/3 EOD (attached).
- Sample retention config showing tenant-level retention (sample_retention_config.yaml) — Dev Patel — 8/4.
- Schedule technical deep-dive (30–45m) with Dev/Rishi + Acme infra/security — proposed 8/6–8/8 (please confirm availability).
- DPA redline: we will send a DocuSign-ready redline for your legal team to review — Marissa — 8/3.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf, Redwood_PenTest_Summary.pdf, sample_retention_config.yaml (these are high-level stubs; we can share the full SOC2 attestation under an NDA if required).

Next steps I need from Acme:
1) Confirm preferred time window for the technical deep-dive (8/6–8/8).
2) Indicate whether 90 days or 1 year retention is the hard requirement for your use case (we can show both configs).
3) Legal lead for the DPA (we assume contact is legal@acme.com — correct?).

If that looks right, I’ll send calendar invites and the DocuSign redline.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs included:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf (summary of controls & attestation dates)
- Redwood_PenTest_Summary.pdf (high-level findings + remediation status)
- sample_retention_config.yaml (example tenant-level retention snippet)

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Legal <legal@acme.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2, audit logs & DPA — recap + next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. A few follow-ups from our side before the deep-dive: 

1) Retention: our baseline requirement for security investigations is 1 year for request-level logs. We can discuss shorter retention for non-security telemetry, but please prepare the 1-year retention config.
2) Audit data: can you confirm that logs include a request ID, timestamp, source IP, model used, and token counts? We need those fields to be present and immutable.
3) Encryption & KMS: confirm whether customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-KMS) are supported in Private deployments or Dedicated; if not, we need detail on key separation and rotation.
4) SOC 2 scope: can you confirm whether the attestation covers the hosted API, data storage, and the logging pipeline (we need visibility into where logs are stored and how they are protected)?
5) Pen test: thanks — we just need a redacted summary (findings, severity, remediation ETA).
6) DPA: please send the redline to legal@acme.com and include any standard subprocessor list or details on processors.

Once we have items 1–5 in writing, we’ll confirm a time for the deep-dive (we prefer mornings Pacific).

Thanks,

Alice Chen
Senior Security Engineer, Acme Corp
alice.chen@acme.com

On Aug 2, 2026, at 2:05 PM, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> (see above)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Acme Legal <legal@acme.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2, audit logs & DPA — recap + next steps

Hi Alice — great, thanks for the clarity. Quick answers and next steps below.

Quick answers: 
- Retention: we will prepare the 1-year tenant-level retention config (sample attached). We’ll also include an example 90-day config for non-security telemetry. (Owner: Dev Patel)
- Audit fields: logs include request ID, timestamp, source IP, model identifier (model_version), token counts, and response latency. We persist request-level metadata in an append-only log that is retained per your selected retention policy. (Owner: Dev/Rishi)
- Encryption & KMS: customer-managed keys are supported in Private deployments and Redwood Dedicated (we use KMS integrations for key wrapping; we will document rotation and separation controls). For hosted API customers we offer provider-managed keys by default; we can discuss a dedicated encryption arrangement under Private/Dedicated.
- SOC 2 scope: the attached summary indicates SOC 2 Type II covers API, storage, and logging pipeline (control mapping included). If you need the full report, we can share under an NDA.
- Pen test: attached is a redacted summary (Redwood_PenTest_Summary.pdf). It lists findings and remediation timelines; we’re happy to walk through any item in the deep-dive.
- DPA & subprocessors: sending a DocuSign redline to Acme Legal now. Link: https://www.docusign.com/fake/ACME-DPA-sign

Concrete next steps I’m executing now:
1) DocuSign DPA redline — Marissa — sent to legal@acme.com (link above).
2) Drive link for SOC2 & pen test artifacts (redacted) — https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/ACME-SOC2 — Marissa — shared.
3) Sample retention config (1 year + 90-day example) — Dev Patel — will post by 8/4.
4) Technical deep-dive (30–45m) — proposed 8/7 09:00 PT. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite (Dev & Rishi will attend).

If that timeline works on your side, I’ll proceed and mark the items in our MSA/deal plan. 

Thanks — talk soon.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124
